stability: Pre-1.0 development specification. Identifiers below are fixed by this registry for QAMZOR software; they are not registered with IANA, Apple or Microsoft (see registry/README.md, section 'Registration status').

formats.title: QAMZOR QZRA archive container

versions.summary: Content-defined chunks, deduplication, plaintext JSON manifest
AES-256-GCM chunk encryption with authenticated, visible manifest
Encrypted manifest (QZ13 envelope) and independent folder passwords

formats.unknown_version_rule: A reader MUST reject any major/minor it does not implement (error category UNSUPPORTED_VERSION) and MUST NOT guess.

crypto.canonical_manifest_json: sorted keys, separators (",", ":"), ensure_ascii=false, UTF-8 (used for the QZRA 1.2 manifest authenticator)

error_categories.AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: An AES-GCM tag failed: wrong password or tampered encrypted data (the two are indistinguishable).
error_categories.INTEGRITY_FAILED: Unencrypted data failed a size, digest or decompression check.
error_categories.INVALID_FORMAT: Malformed header, manifest, layout, or truncated archive.
error_categories.UNSAFE_PATH: An entry path is absolute, traverses upward, is a Windows device name, or otherwise unsafe.
error_categories.UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: Header version not implemented by the reader.
